description: This file defines a React component called ActivityFeed that displays a list of recent system activities, each with icons, timestamps, statuses, and optional connector IDs. It includes utility functions for formatting time, selecting icons, and determining colors based on activity properties.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats a timestamp string into a relative time description like 'Just now', '5m ago', '2h ago' or a localized date.

methods.name: getActivityIcon
methods.description: Returns an emoji icon representing the activity type.

methods.name: getActivityColor
methods.description: Determines background and border colors based on activity status.
